title: Participant
description: Any entity capable of contributing to a Mission: human, organization, AI agent, robot, or external system. See docs/protocol/07-participants.md.

externalRef.description: Implementation-specific identity this participant points at (e.g. a user or organization id). Identity is external to the protocol — see docs/protocol/02-design-principles.md section 18.

trustScore.description: Implementation-defined confidence metric; the protocol does not define scoring.

capabilities.description: Capability codes this participant has been attached to.
